verdict.rationale: Evidence shows three.js uses modern ES module patterns (import maps) and a modular architecture where renderers/addons (SVG, CSS3D) are separate from the core, implying tree-shakable, bundler-friendly design, and community notes it works flawlessly with TypeScript. However, there is no explicit mention of npm/registry installation instructions or bundler-specific tree-shaking guidance in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit 'npm install three' or registry publishing evidence, documented bundler (webpack/vite/rollup) integration guidance, and independent confirmation of tree-shaking behavior in production builds.
